I see there is a log message saying the inference provider API keys are available but then they don't get picked up by the agent. 25	// killStaleAgent sends SIGTERM (then SIGKILL after 2 s) to any running
26	// processes whose executable matches the given binary name.
27	func killStaleAgent(binaryPath string) {
28		if binaryPath == "" {
29			return
30		}
31		binaryName := filepath.Base(binaryPath)
32		if cmd := exec.Command("pkill", "-TERM", "-x", binaryName); cmd.Run() == nil {
33			time.Sleep(1 * time.Second)
34		}
35		exec.Command("pkill", "-KILL", "-x", binaryName).Run() //nolint:errcheck
36	}

38	// waitForPortFree blocks until the given TCP port is no longer occupied or
39	// the deadline is reached. Returns true if the port is free.
40	func waitForPortFree(port int, deadline time.Duration) bool {
41		end := time.Now().Add(deadline)
42		for time.Now().Before(end) {
43			ln, err := net.Listen("tcp", fmt.Sprintf(":%d", port))
44			if err == nil {
45				ln.Close()
46				return true
47			}
48			time.Sleep(200 * time.Millisecond)
49		}
50		return false
51	}

112	func waitForSocket(socketPath string, deadline time.Duration) bool {
113		end := time.Now().Add(deadline)
114		for time.Now().Before(end) {
115			if _, err := os.Stat(socketPath); err == nil {
116				// Socket file exists — verify it's actually listening
117				conn, err := net.DialTimeout("unix", socketPath, 100*time.Millisecond)
118				if err == nil {
119					conn.Close()
120					return true
121				}
122			}
123			time.Sleep(100 * time.Millisecond)
124		}
125		return false
126	}

214		}

227	// StartAgent spawns a new KNIRVAGENT subprocess for the given DVE ID.
228	// It blocks until the agent's socket is ready (up to StartTimeout).
229	func (am *AgentManager) StartAgent(ctx context.Context, dveID string, startTimeout time.Duration) (*AgentProcess, error) {
230		am.mu.Lock()
231	
232		// Check if already running
233		if existing, ok := am.agents[dveID]; ok && existing.isHealthy() {
234			am.mu.Unlock()
235			am.logger.Info("Agent already running for DVE", zap.String("dveID", dveID))
236			return existing, nil
237		}
238	
239		// Check max concurrent limit
240		if len(am.agents) >= am.maxConcurrent {
241			am.mu.Unlock()
242			return nil, fmt.Errorf("max concurrent agents reached (%d/%d)",
243				len(am.agents), am.maxConcurrent)
244		}
245	
246		resolvedPath := am.binaryPath
247		if resolvedPath == "" {
248			var err error
249			resolvedPath, err = resolveBinaryPath("./knirvagent")
250			if err != nil {
251				am.mu.Unlock()
252				return nil, fmt.Errorf("KNIRVAGENT binary not found: %w", err)
253			}
254		}
255	
256		socketPath := filepath.Join(am.socketDir, fmt.Sprintf("agent-%s.sock", dveID))
257	
258		// Kill any stale instance for this DVE
259		killStaleAgent(resolvedPath)
260		os.Remove(socketPath)
261	
262		am.logger.Info("Starting KNIRVAGENT for DVE",
263			zap.String("dveID", dveID),
264			zap.String("socket", socketPath),
265			zap.String("binary", resolvedPath))
266	
267		// Build command — the agent runs the `server` subcommand which listens
268		// on a Unix socket (agent-{dveID}.sock) and exposes POST /api/execute.
269		args := []string{
270			"server",
271			"--dve-id", dveID,
272			"--socket-path", socketPath,
273		}
274	
275		cmd := exec.Command(resolvedPath, args...)
276		cmd.Env = os.Environ()
277		cmd.Env = append(cmd.Env, am.extraEnv...)
278		cmd.Stdout = os.Stdout
279		cmd.Stderr = os.Stderr
280		cmd.SysProcAttr = &syscall.SysProcAttr{
281			Setpgid: true,
282		}
283	
284		if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
285			am.mu.Unlock()
286			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to start KNIRVAGENT for DVE %s: %w", dveID, err)
287		}
288	
289		pid := cmd.Process.Pid
290	
291		ap := &AgentProcess{
292			DVEID:      dveID,
293			Cmd:        cmd,
294			SocketPath: socketPath,
295			PID:        pid,
296			StartedAt:  time.Now(),
297			Healthy:    false,
298		}
299	
300		am.agents[dveID] = ap
301		am.mu.Unlock()
302	
303		// Wait for the socket to appear (outside the lock)
304		if startTimeout <= 0 {
305			startTimeout = 30 * time.Second
306		}
307		if !waitForSocket(socketPath, startTimeout) {
308			// Socket didn't appear — kill the process group
309			syscall.Kill(-cmd.Process.Pid, syscall.SIGKILL)
310			am.mu.Lock()
311			delete(am.agents, dveID)
312			am.mu.Unlock()
313			return nil, fmt.Errorf("timeout waiting for agent socket %s for DVE %s", socketPath, dveID)
314		}
315	
316		ap.setHealthy(true)
317	
318		am.logger.Info("KNIRVAGENT started for DVE",
319			zap.String("dveID", dveID),
320			zap.Int("pid", pid),
321			zap.String("socket", socketPath))
322	
323		return ap, nil
324	}

326	// StopAgent stops the agent subprocess for the given DVE ID.
327	func (am *AgentManager) StopAgent(dveID string, stopTimeout time.Duration) error {
328		am.mu.Lock()
329		ap, ok := am.agents[dveID]
330		if !ok {
331			am.mu.Unlock()
332			return nil // idempotent — already stopped
333		}
334		delete(am.agents, dveID)
335		am.mu.Unlock()
336	
337		if ap.Cmd == nil || ap.Cmd.Process == nil {
338			os.Remove(ap.SocketPath)
339			return nil
340		}
341	
342		am.logger.Info("Stopping KNIRVAGENT for DVE",
343			zap.String("dveID", dveID),
344			zap.Int("pid", ap.PID))
345	
346		// Send SIGTERM
347		if err := ap.Cmd.Process.Signal(syscall.SIGTERM); err != nil {
348			am.logger.Warn("Failed to send SIGTERM to agent, forcing kill",
349				zap.String("dveID", dveID),
350				zap.Error(err))
351			syscall.Kill(-ap.Cmd.Process.Pid, syscall.SIGKILL)
352		}
353	
354		done := make(chan error, 1)
355		go func() {
356			done <- ap.Cmd.Wait()
357		}()
358	
359		if stopTimeout <= 0 {
360			stopTimeout = 10 * time.Second
361		}
362	
363		select {
364		case <-done:
365			ap.setHealthy(false)
366			os.Remove(ap.SocketPath)
367			am.logger.Info("KNIRVAGENT stopped for DVE", zap.String("dveID", dveID))
368			return nil
369		case <-time.After(stopTimeout):
370			am.logger.Warn("Timeout waiting for agent shutdown, forcing kill",
371				zap.String("dveID", dveID))
372			syscall.Kill(-ap.Cmd.Process.Pid, syscall.SIGKILL)
373			ap.setHealthy(false)
374			os.Remove(ap.SocketPath)
375			return fmt.Errorf("forced shutdown of agent for DVE %s after timeout", dveID)
376		}
377	}

415	// StopAll stops every agent process in parallel with a global timeout.
416	func (am *AgentManager) StopAll(ctx context.Context) error {
417		am.mu.RLock()
418		dveIDs := make([]string, 0, len(am.agents))
419		for dveID := range am.agents {
420			dveIDs = append(dveIDs, dveID)
421		}
422		am.mu.RUnlock()
423	
424		if len(dveIDs) == 0 {
425			return nil
426		}
427	
428		am.logger.Info("Stopping all KNIRVAGENT processes", zap.Int("count", len(dveIDs)))
429	
430		var wg sync.WaitGroup
431		errCh := make(chan error, len(dveIDs))
432	
433		for _, dveID := range dveIDs {
434			wg.Add(1)
435			go func(id string) {
436				defer wg.Done()
437				if err := am.StopAgent(id, 10*time.Second); err != nil {
438					errCh <- err
439				}
440			}(dveID)
441		}
442	
443		doneCh := make(chan struct{})
444		go func() {
445			wg.Wait()
446			close(doneCh)
447		}()
448	
449		select {
450		case <-doneCh:
451			close(errCh)
452			// Collect any errors
453			var errs []error
454			for err := range errCh {
455				errs = append(errs, err)
456			}
457			if len(errs) > 0 {
458				return fmt.Errorf("errors stopping agents: %v", errs)
459			}
460			return nil
461		case <-ctx.Done():

463		case <-time.After(15 * time.Second):
464			return fmt.Errorf("timeout stopping all agents after 15s")
465		}
466	}

529	func (am *AgentManager) StartPeriodicHealthCheck(ctx context.Context) {
530		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
531		am.stopHealthCheck = cancel
532	
533		am.wg.Add(1)
534		go func() {
535			defer am.wg.Done()
536			ticker := time.NewTicker(am.healthInterval)
537			defer ticker.Stop()
538	
539			for {
540				select {
541				case <-ctx.Done():
542					return
543				case <-ticker.C:
544					am.reapUnhealthy()
545				}
546			}
547		}()
548	
549		am.logger.Info("Periodic agent health check started",
550			zap.Duration("interval", am.healthInterval))
551	}

561	// reapUnhealthy checks all agents and removes any whose process has exited
562	// or whose socket is gone.
563	func (am *AgentManager) reapUnhealthy() {
564		am.mu.RLock()
565		snapshot := make([]*AgentProcess, 0, len(am.agents))
566		for _, ap := range am.agents {
567			snapshot = append(snapshot, ap)
568		}
569		am.mu.RUnlock()
570	
571		for _, ap := range snapshot {
572			// Check if socket still exists
573			if _, err := os.Stat(ap.SocketPath); os.IsNotExist(err) {
574				am.logger.Warn("Agent socket missing, reaping",
575					zap.String("dveID", ap.DVEID),
576					zap.String("socket", ap.SocketPath))
577				am.mu.Lock()
578				// Re-check inside lock to avoid race
579				if existing, ok := am.agents[ap.DVEID]; ok && existing.SocketPath == ap.SocketPath {
580					delete(am.agents, ap.DVEID)
581				}
582				am.mu.Unlock()
583				continue
584			}
585	
586			// Check if process is still alive
587			if ap.Cmd != nil && ap.Cmd.Process != nil {
588				if err := ap.Cmd.Process.Signal(syscall.Signal(0)); err != nil {
589					// Process is gone
590					am.logger.Warn("Agent process exited, reaping",
591						zap.String("dveID", ap.DVEID),
592						zap.Int("pid", ap.PID))
593					ap.setHealthy(false)
594					os.Remove(ap.SocketPath)
595					am.mu.Lock()
596					if existing, ok := am.agents[ap.DVEID]; ok && existing.PID == ap.PID {
597						delete(am.agents, ap.DVEID)
598					}
599					am.mu.Unlock()
600				}
601			}

content.text:
Three bugs fixed across three files. Here's what was wrong and what changed:

---

### Bug 1 — Wrong lazy-provisioning condition (`dve_handlers.go`)

Both `GetSupervisorAgentStatus` and `GetSupervisorAgentSession` guarded their lazy-provision block with `!IsRunning()` — meaning "start an agent if no agents are running at all." If DVE-A's agent was already alive, accessing DVE-B completely skipped provisioning and immediately returned 503.

**Fix:** Changed to `GetSocketPathForDVE(nodeID) != nil` — provisioning now fires per-DVE, regardless of whether other DVEs' agents are running. The subsequent `IsRunning()` guard is also removed in favor of a single `GetSocketPathForDVE` check.

---

### Bug 2 — JSON-quoted command string (`dve_agent_ws_handler.go`)

The WebSocket `readPump` was calling `forwardInput(conn, string(msg.Data))` where `msg.Data` is `json.RawMessage`. Raw JSON bytes for a string value include surrounding `"` quotes, so the user typing `help` arrived at the agent's `/api/execute` as `{"command": "\"help\""}` — the inference provider was never reached.

**Fix:** `json.Unmarshal(msg.Data, &inputStr)` to properly decode the string before forwarding.

---

### Bug 3 — Empty socket dir (`pkg/knirvagent/manager.go`)

When `SocketPath` wasn't configured in `ManagerConfig`, `socketDir` remained empty and socket files were created in the process CWD (unreliable in production).

**Fix:** `NewManager` now defaults `socketDir` to `getAgentAppDataDir()/sockets`, and `StartAgent` calls `os.MkdirAll` on that path before creating the socket file.

content: Fixed three backend bugs preventing KNIRVAGENT from connecting in the DVE terminal: wrong per-DVE provisioning logic, JSON-quoted commands never reaching the inference provider, and unstable socket directory. Next: restart KNIRVSERVER and test the agent console in a DVE workspace. (disable recaps in /config)

content.text:
Found it. In `LoadConfig`, the early-return on `os.IsNotExist` skips both `env.Parse` and the `simpleKeyFallbacks` block — so when the agent runs in a fresh DVE without a pre-existing config file, it gets `DefaultConfig()` with all API keys empty, then immediately crashes.

Let me read the KNIRVAGENT main.go to confirm the call path, then fix `LoadConfig`.

content.text:
You'll need to copy the binary yourself. Run this in your terminal:

```bash
sudo cp packages/KNIRVAGENT/build/knirvagent /var/lib/knirvserver/bin/knirvagent
```

The binary was built at `packages/KNIRVAGENT/build/knirvagent`. After copying, restart KNIRVSERVER and the agent will load API keys from the environment correctly.

---

Here's the full picture of what was wrong and what changed:

**Root cause — `LoadConfig` bailed out before applying env vars**

In `packages/KNIRVAGENT/pkg/config/config.go`, `LoadConfig` had an early `return cfg, nil` on `os.IsNotExist`. The KNIRVAGENT subprocess runs with no pre-existing `~/.knirvagent/config.json`, so it always hit that branch and got the bare `DefaultConfig()` — all `cfg.Providers.*` fields empty. The `env.Parse(cfg)` call and the `simpleKeyFallbacks` block (which maps `GEMINI_API_KEY` → `cfg.Providers.Gemini.APIKey`) were unreachable. The agent saw the env vars were set, failed to load them into the config, logged "no API keys configured", and crashed — which destroyed the socket before the first WebSocket command arrived.

**Fix:** Changed the `os.IsNotExist` branch from an early return to a no-op (skip JSON unmarshal, continue), so `env.Parse` and `simpleKeyFallbacks` always run. The existing fallback map already correctly maps `GEMINI_API_KEY` → Gemini, `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` → DeepSeek, `CEREBRAS_API_KEY` → ShengSuanYun — it just needed to be reachable.

Run this in your terminal to deploy:

```bash
sudo cp packages/KNIRVAGENT/build/knirvagent /var/lib/knirvserver/bin/knirvagent
```

Then restart KNIRVSERVER so the old agent subprocess is killed and a fresh one with the new binary is spawned next time you open the DVE console.

---

Here's what changed and why:

**`pkg/agent/loop.go`** — Added `FallbackEntry` type, `fallbackEntries` field on `AgentLoop`, `SetFallbackProviders` method, and `isProviderAuthError` helper. In `runLLMIteration`, when `al.provider.Chat()` returns an error matching auth patterns (HTTP 400/401/403, "invalid api key", "unauthorized", etc.), it iterates through `al.fallbackEntries` and tries each one. The first fallback that succeeds permanently replaces `al.provider` and `al.model` for the rest of that session — no wasted retries on the bad key.

**`cmd/knirvagent/main.go`** — Added `buildRuntimeFallbacks` which walks `defaultFallbackChain` (skipping the primary provider and any without keys) and pre-creates each fallback `LLMProvider` at startup. 2. Key Technical Concepts:
- DVE (Dynamic Virtual Environment) — sovereign blockchain container with a per-DVE KNIRVAGENT subprocess
- KNIRVAGENT — Go binary that runs as a subprocess, listens on a Unix socket (`/var/lib/knirvserver/sockets/agent-{dveID}.sock`), exposes `POST /api/execute` and `GET /health`
- Unix socket proxying — KNIRVSERVER WebSocket handler dials the agent's socket and forwards HTTP requests
- Provider fallback chain — Gemini → DeepSeek → ShengSuanYun/Cerebras → OpenAI → Anthropic → Groq → OpenRouter
- `json.RawMessage` — stores raw JSON bytes including surrounding quotes, must be `json.Unmarshal`-ed to get plain string
- Lazy provisioning — starting the per-DVE agent subprocess on first access rather than at server boot
- xterm.js — frontend terminal library with ANSI escape code support
- `r.Context()` vs server `ctx` — HTTP request context for proper cancellation propagation

**`packages/KNIRVSERVER/backend/internal/web/dve_agent_ws_handler.go`**
- WebSocket proxy between frontend terminal and KNIRVAGENT Unix socket
- Fixed JSON quoting bug: `json.Unmarshal(msg.Data, &inputStr)` instead of `string(msg.Data)`

}

func LoadConfig(path string) (*Config, error) {
    cfg := DefaultConfig()
    data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
    if err != nil && !os.IsNotExist(err) {
        return nil, err
    }
    if err == nil {
        if err := json.Unmarshal(data, cfg); err != nil {

        }

    if err := env.Parse(cfg); err != nil {
        return nil, err

    // Fallback: accept simple env var names (GEMINI_API_KEY, DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, etc.)
    simpleKeyFallbacks := map[string]func(*Config) *string{
        "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY": func(c *Config) *string { return &c.Providers.Anthropic.APIKey },
        "DEEPSEEK_API_KEY":  func(c *Config) *string { return &c.Providers.DeepSeek.APIKey },

        "CEREBRAS_API_KEY":  func(c *Config) *string { return &c.Providers.ShengSuanYun.APIKey },

---
name: dve-knirvagent-bugs
description: Three bugs fixed in the DVE KNIRVAGENT socket connection and agent provisioning flow
metadata: 
  node_type: memory
  type: project
  originSessionId: 45a58647-cfa2-4884-a24f-95ad86862818
---

Three bugs were fixed in `packages/KNIRVSERVER` to make KNIRVAGENT connect through the DVE SSH Terminal console.

**Bug 1 — Wrong lazy-provisioning condition (`dve_handlers.go`)**
`GetSupervisorAgentStatus` and `GetSupervisorAgentSession` both used `!IsRunning()` (any agent running) instead of checking whether THIS DVE's agent was running. Fix: replaced with `GetSocketPathForDVE(nodeID) != nil` so provisioning fires per-DVE regardless of other agents.

**Why:** If DVE-A's agent was alive, accessing DVE-B skipped provisioning and immediately returned 503.

**Bug 2 — JSON-quoted command string (`dve_agent_ws_handler.go`)**
`forwardInput` received `string(msg.Data)` where `msg.Data` is `json.RawMessage` — the JSON string encoding includes surrounding `"` quotes. Commands arrived at the agent as `"help"` instead of `help`, so the inference provider was never reached.
Fix: `json.Unmarshal(msg.Data, &inputStr)` before passing to `forwardInput`.

**Bug 3 — Empty socket dir (`pkg/knirvagent/manager.go`)**
When `SocketPath` was not configured, `socketDir` was empty and socket files landed in the process CWD. Fix: default `socketDir` to `getAgentAppDataDir()/sockets` and call `os.MkdirAll(socketDir)` at the start of `StartAgent`.

**How to apply:** When touching the KNIRVAGENT manager or DVE session handlers, always verify lazy-provisioning is per-DVE and that JSON input is properly unmarshaled before forwarding.

254	func copyEmbeddedToTarget(targetDir string) error {
255		// Ensure target directory exists
256		if err := os.MkdirAll(targetDir, 0755); err != nil {
257			return fmt.Errorf("Failed to create target directory: %w", err)
258		}
259	
260		// Walk through all files in embed.FS
261		err := fs.WalkDir(embeddedFiles, "workspace", func(path string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
262			if err != nil {
263				return err
264			}
265	
266			// Skip directories
267			if d.IsDir() {
268				return nil
269			}
270	
271			// Read embedded file
272			data, err := embeddedFiles.ReadFile(path)
273			if err != nil {
274				return fmt.Errorf("Failed to read embedded file %s: %w", path, err)
275			}
276	
277			new_path, err := filepath.Rel("workspace", path)
278			if err != nil {
279				return fmt.Errorf("Failed to get relative path for %s: %v\n", path, err)
280			}
281	
282			// Build target file path
283			targetPath := filepath.Join(targetDir, new_path)
284	
285			// Ensure target file's directory exists
286			if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(targetPath), 0755); err != nil {
287				return fmt.Errorf("Failed to create directory %s: %w", filepath.Dir(targetPath), err)
288			}
289	
290			// Write file
291			if err := os.WriteFile(targetPath, data, 0644); err != nil {
292				return fmt.Errorf("Failed to write file %s: %w", targetPath, err)
293			}
294	
295			return nil
296		})
297	
298		return err
299	}

684	// serverCmd starts an HTTP server on a Unix socket that accepts command
685	// execution requests. Designed for use as a managed subprocess by KNIRVSERVER's
686	// AgentManager — each DVE gets its own agent process with its own socket.
687	//
688	// Usage: knirvagent server --dve-id <id> --socket-path <path>
689	func serverCmd() {
690		dveID := ""
691		socketPath := ""
692	
693		args := os.Args[2:]
694		for i := 0; i < len(args); i++ {
695			switch args[i] {
696			case "--dve-id":
697				if i+1 < len(args) {
698					dveID = args[i+1]
699					i++
700				}
701			case "--socket-path":
702				if i+1 < len(args) {
703					socketPath = args[i+1]
704					i++
705				}
706			case "--debug", "-d":
707				logger.SetLevel(logger.DEBUG)
708			case "--help", "-h":
709				fmt.Println("Usage: knirvagent server --dve-id <id> --socket-path <path>")
710				fmt.Println()
711				fmt.Println("Starts the agent as an HTTP server on a Unix socket.")
712				fmt.Println("Accepts POST /api/execute for command execution,")
713				fmt.Println("GET /health for health checks.")
714				return
715			}
716		}
717	
718		if socketPath == "" {
719			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error: --socket-path is required\n")
720			os.Exit(1)
721		}
722	
723		// Remove any existing socket file
724		os.Remove(socketPath)
725	
726		cfg, err := loadConfig()
727		if err != nil {
728			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error loading config: %v\n", err)
729			os.Exit(1)
730		}
731	
732		// Debug: log what the config actually has after loading
733		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] DEBUG: cfg.Providers.Gemini.APIKey=%q (len=%d)\n",
734			cfg.Providers.Gemini.APIKey, len(cfg.Providers.Gemini.APIKey))
735		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] DEBUG: cfg.Providers.DeepSeek.APIKey=%q (len=%d)\n",
736			cfg.Providers.DeepSeek.APIKey, len(cfg.Providers.DeepSeek.APIKey))
737		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] DEBUG: cfg.Providers.ShengSuanYun.APIKey=%q (len=%d)\n",
738			cfg.Providers.ShengSuanYun.APIKey, len(cfg.Providers.ShengSuanYun.APIKey))
739		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] DEBUG: cfg.Providers.OpenRouter.APIKey=%q (len=%d)\n",
740			cfg.Providers.OpenRouter.APIKey, len(cfg.Providers.OpenRouter.APIKey))
741		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] DEBUG: cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider=%q\n",
742			cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider)
743		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] DEBUG: cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model=%q\n",
744			cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model)
745	
746		// Debug: log whether API keys are available as env vars
747		for _, key := range []string{"GEMINI_API_KEY", "DEEPSEEK_API_KEY", "CEREBRAS_API_KEY", "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY", "OPENAI_API_KEY"} {
748			if val, ok := os.LookupEnv(key); ok && val != "" {
749				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] DEBUG: %s is set (len=%d)\n", key, len(val))
750			} else if ok {
751				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] DEBUG: %s is set but EMPTY\n", key)
752			} else {
753				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] DEBUG: %s is NOT SET\n", key)
754			}
755		}
756	
757		provider, err := createProviderWithFallback(cfg)
758		if err != nil {
759			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error creating provider: %v\n", err)
760			os.Exit(1)
761		}
762	
763		// Build runtime fallback providers so the agent can switch on auth errors.
764		// We pre-create each provider here (at startup) so there's no overhead at
765		// the time of the actual fallback.
766		runtimeFallbacks := buildRuntimeFallbacks(cfg)
767	
768		// Create the Unix socket FIRST, before any potentially-blocking agent
769		// initialization.  This ensures the parent (AgentManager.StartAgent)
770		// sees the socket immediately via waitForSocket, avoiding the 30-second
771		// timeout that would otherwise kill the agent process.
772		listener, err := net.Listen("unix", socketPath)
773		if err != nil {
774			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error listening on socket %s: %v\n", socketPath, err)
775			os.Exit(1)
776		}
777		defer listener.Close()
778		defer os.Remove(socketPath)
779	
780		// Set permissions so the backend_server can connect
781		os.Chmod(socketPath, 0666)
782	
783		msgBus := bus.NewMessageBus()
784		agentLoop := agent.NewAgentLoop(cfg, msgBus, provider)
785		agentLoop.SetFallbackProviders(runtimeFallbacks)
786	
787		// Start the agent loop in the background
788		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
789		defer cancel()
790		go agentLoop.Run(ctx)
791	
792		// Print startup info
793		startupInfo := agentLoop.GetStartupInfo()
794		toolsInfo := startupInfo["tools"].(map[string]interface{})
795		skillsInfo := startupInfo["skills"].(map[string]interface{})
796		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] DVE=%s socket=%s tools=%d skills=%d/%d\n",
797			dveID, socketPath, toolsInfo["count"], skillsInfo["available"], skillsInfo["total"])
798	
799		mux := http.NewServeMux()
800		mux.HandleFunc("/health", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
801			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
802			json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]interface{}{
803				"status":   "ok",
804				"dve_id":   dveID,
805				"provider": cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider,
806				"model":    cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model,
807			})
808		})
809		mux.HandleFunc("/api/execute", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
810			if r.Method != "POST" {
811				http.Error(w, "method not allowed", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
812				return
813			}
814	
815			var req struct {
816				Command string `json:"command"`
817			}
818			if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
819				json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]interface{}{
820					"success": false,
821					"error":   "invalid request: " + err.Error(),
822				})
823				return
824			}
825	
826			if req.Command == "" {
827				json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]interface{}{
828					"success": false,
829					"error":   "command is required",
830				})
831				return
832			}
833	
834			// Use the HTTP request's context so that if the caller (KNIRVSERVER
835			// WebSocket proxy) disconnects or times out, the LLM call is cancelled
836			// rather than continuing to consume the server-wide context.
837			response, err := agentLoop.ProcessDirect(r.Context(), req.Command, dveID+":terminal")
838			if err != nil {
839				json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]interface{}{
840					"success": false,
841					"error":   err.Error(),
842				})
843				return
844			}
845	
846			json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]interface{}{
847				"success": true,
848				"output":  response,
849			})
850		})
851	
852		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] Listening on %s\n", socketPath)
853	
854		// Serve until shutdown signal
855		sigChan := make(chan os.Signal, 1)
856		signal.Notify(sigChan, os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)
857	
858		go func() {
859			<-sigChan
860			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] Shutting down...\n")
861			cancel()
862			listener.Close()
863		}()
864	
865		if err := http.Serve(listener, mux); err != nil {
866			if !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "use of closed network connection") {
867				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] Server error: %v\n", err)
868			}
869		}
870	
871		agentLoop.Stop()
872		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[KNIRVAGENT] Stopped\n")
873	}

875	// ──────────────────────────────────────────────
876	// Provider fallback — try configured provider first, then fall back through
877	// alternative providers that have API keys configured.  This lets the agent
878	// start even when the default model (gemini-2.0-flash / Gemini) has no key
879	// but other providers (DeepSeek, ShengSuanYun, OpenAI, etc.) do.
880	// ──────────────────────────────────────────────
881	
882	// providerFallback defines one candidate in the fallback chain.
883	type providerFallback struct {
884		Provider string
885		Model    string // empty means leave the model at whatever CreateProvider picks
886	}
887	
888	// defaultFallbackChain is the order of providers to try, from most preferred
889	// to least.  The first entry is always the user-configured provider/model.
890	var defaultFallbackChain = []providerFallback{
891		// Entry 0 is a sentinel — filled in at runtime with the configured provider/model.
892		{Provider: "", Model: ""},
893		{Provider: "deepseek", Model: "deepseek-chat"},
894		{Provider: "shengsuanyun", Model: ""},
895		{Provider: "openai", Model: "gpt-4o-mini"},
896		{Provider: "anthropic", Model: "claude-sonnet-4-20250514"},
897		{Provider: "groq", Model: "llama-3.3-70b-versatile"},
898		// Last resort — use OpenRouter if any key is set.  It proxies many models.
899		{Provider: "openrouter", Model: "google/gemini-2.0-flash"},
900	}
901	
902	// hasAPIKeyFor returns true when the given provider has a non-empty API key
903	// in the config.  This avoids attempting provider creation only to fail again.
904	func hasAPIKeyFor(cfg *config.Config, providerName string) bool {
905		switch strings.ToLower(providerName) {
906		case "gemini", "google":
907			return cfg.Providers.Gemini.APIKey != ""
908		case "deepseek":
909			return cfg.Providers.DeepSeek.APIKey != ""
910		case "shengsuanyun", "cerebras":
911			return cfg.Providers.ShengSuanYun.APIKey != ""
912		case "openai", "gpt":
913			return cfg.Providers.OpenAI.APIKey != "" || cfg.Providers.OpenAI.AuthMethod != ""
914		case "anthropic", "claude":
915			return cfg.Providers.Anthropic.APIKey != "" || cfg.Providers.Anthropic.AuthMethod != ""
916		case "openrouter":
917			return cfg.Providers.OpenRouter.APIKey != ""
918		case "groq":
919			return cfg.Providers.Groq.APIKey != ""
920		case "vllm":
921			return cfg.Providers.VLLM.APIBase != ""
922		default:
923			return false
924		}
925	}
926	
927	// createProviderWithFallback tries the configured provider first.  If it
928	// fails (e.g. no API key for the default model), it walks the fallback chain
929	// looking for a provider with an available API key.  When a fallback succeeds,
930	// it updates cfg.Agents.Defaults so the rest of the agent (subagent manager,
931	// context builder, etc.) uses the correct provider and model.
932	func createProviderWithFallback(cfg *config.Config) (providers.LLMProvider, error) {
933		// Build the chain starting with the user-configured provider/model.
934		chain := make([]providerFallback, len(defaultFallbackChain))
935		copy(chain, defaultFallbackChain)
936		chain[0] = providerFallback{
937			Provider: cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider,
938			Model:    cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model,
939		}
940	
941		origProvider := cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider
942		origModel := cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model
943	
944		for i, fb := range chain {
945			if fb.Provider == "" {
946				continue
947			}
948			if !hasAPIKeyFor(cfg, fb.Provider) {
949				continue
950			}
951	
952			cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider = fb.Provider
953			if fb.Model != "" {
954				cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model = fb.Model
955			}
956	
957			provider, err := providers.CreateProvider(cfg)
958			if err == nil {
959				if i > 0 {
960					fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr,
961						"[KNIRVAGENT] Provider %q (model: %q) unavailable, "+
962							"falling back to %q (model: %q)\n",
963						chain[0].Provider, chain[0].Model,
964						fb.Provider, cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model)
965				}
966				return provider, nil
967			}
968	
969			// Restore before trying the next fallback
970			cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider = origProvider
971			cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model = origModel
972		}
973	
974		// Every provider failed — build a helpful error message
975		var available []string
976		for _, fb := range chain {
977			if fb.Provider != "" && hasAPIKeyFor(cfg, fb.Provider) {
978				available = append(available, fb.Provider)
979			}
980		}
981		if len(available) > 0 {
982			return nil, fmt.Errorf(
983				"no usable provider: %q has no valid API key (models %q), "+
984					"and fallback providers failed. "+
985					"Available providers with keys: %v",
986				chain[0].Provider, chain[0].Model, available)
987		}
988		return nil, fmt.Errorf(
989			"no API keys configured for any provider. "+
990				"Ensure root.key contains at least one API key "+
991				"(Gemini, DeepSeek, etc.)")
992	}
993	
994	// buildRuntimeFallbacks pre-creates all fallback providers (excluding the
995	// one already chosen as primary) so the AgentLoop can switch at runtime when
996	// an auth error occurs.  Providers with no API key are silently skipped.
997	func buildRuntimeFallbacks(cfg *config.Config) []agent.FallbackEntry {
998		primaryProvider := strings.ToLower(cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider)
999		origProvider := cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider
1000		origModel := cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model
1001	
1002		var entries []agent.FallbackEntry
1003		for _, fb := range defaultFallbackChain[1:] {
1004			if fb.Provider == "" {
1005				continue
1006			}
1007			if strings.EqualFold(fb.Provider, primaryProvider) {
1008				continue // already the primary
1009			}
1010			if !hasAPIKeyFor(cfg, fb.Provider) {
1011				continue
1012			}
1013	
1014			cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider = fb.Provider
1015			if fb.Model != "" {
1016				cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model = fb.Model
1017			} else {
1018				cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model = origModel
1019			}
1020	
1021			p, err := providers.CreateProvider(cfg)
1022			if err != nil {
1023				cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider = origProvider
1024				cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model = origModel
1025				continue
1026			}
1027	
1028			model := cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model
1029			entries = append(entries, agent.FallbackEntry{
1030				Provider: p,
1031				Model:    model,
1032				Name:     fb.Provider,
1033			})
1034	
1035			cfg.Agents.Defaults.Provider = origProvider
1036			cfg.Agents.Defaults.Model = origModel
1037		}
1038	
1039		return entries
1040	}
